theme: Global pop girls: KATSEYE and company
editorNotes: Added from your pop-culture notes: KATSEYE, PinkPantheress, and original fangirl references. Main quiz and Ask share a theme, with distinct Ask answers. Reference URLs need source review before approval.

daily.question: How many members debuted in KATSEYE in 2024?
daily.explanation: KATSEYE debuted with Sophia, Manon, Daniela, Lara, Megan, and Yoonchae.

daily.question: KATSEYE’s first EP expanded S.I.S. into which phrase?
daily.explanation: Their 2024 EP is titled S.I.S. (Soft Is Strong).

daily.question: KATSEYE’s first official single, released in June 2024, was…
daily.explanation: Debut was the group’s first official single; Touch followed in July 2024.

daily.question: Which KATSEYE member is from Switzerland?
daily.explanation: Manon Bannerman is the Swiss member of the group.

daily.question: Little Mix became the first group to win which UK competition in 2011?
daily.explanation: Little Mix won the eighth UK series of The X Factor in 2011.

daily.question: Fifth Harmony’s “Work from Home” features which artist?
daily.explanation: Ty Dolla Sign features on the group’s 2016 single Work from Home.

daily.question: The Spice Girls’ debut single was…
daily.explanation: Wannabe was released as the Spice Girls’ debut single in 1996.

daily.question: BLACKPINK debuted with how many members?
daily.explanation: BLACKPINK debuted with Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, and Lisa.

daily.question: “Say My Name” appeared on which Destiny’s Child album?
daily.explanation: Say My Name appears on the group’s 1999 album The Writing’s on the Wall.

tumblr.question: Which One Direction album includes “Little Things”?
tumblr.explanation: Little Things appears on Take Me Home, released in 2012.

tumblr.question: Which actor played Dean Winchester?
tumblr.explanation: Jensen Ackles played Dean in Supernatural.

tumblr.question: Which actor played Sam Winchester?
tumblr.explanation: Jared Padalecki played Sam in Supernatural.

tumblr.question: A fic described as a “one-shot” is usually…
options: A self-contained story in one installment
tumblr.explanation: A one-shot is a single, self-contained installment.

youtube.question: Liza Koshy’s name on Vine was…
youtube.explanation: Liza Koshy became known on Vine under Lizzza.

modern.question: Kurtis Conner’s fan community is often called…

A private friendship between two creators
